description: The bar chart illustrates sentiment classification accuracy for two tweet subsets using three annotation methods. The horizontal axis contains two categories, “Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweet,” presented left to right, and the x-axis caption reads “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis.” The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” and uses a linear scale from 0.0 to 0.8 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.2 intervals. For “Emoji Tweets,” three adjacent bars are shown: a white bar labeled TEXTBLOB at approximately 0.33, a white diagonally hatched bar labeled VADER at approximately 0.45, and a solid green bar labeled ChatGPT at approximately 0.67. For “Overall Tweet,” the same three-method grouping appears: TEXTBLOB (white) at approximately 0.40, VADER (white with diagonal hatching) at approximately 0.47, and ChatGPT (solid green) at approximately 0.66. The bars are grouped by tweet subset with consistent color/texture encoding indicated by an in-plot legend (TEXTBLOB, VADER, ChatGPT), and there is no visual indication that bars are sorted beyond the fixed left-to-right category order or that any bars are specially emphasized beyond the distinct green fill for ChatGPT and hatching for VADER.
